name: Collatz River
desc: Thousands of Collatz (3n+1) hailstone orbits stream out from a shared root as smooth strands that bend gently on even steps and sharply on odd, braiding into a glowing coral river-delta hued violet-young to gold-old on dark water.

density.doc: strand stream rate + integer pool size (delta richness)

curl.doc: per-step turn magnitude (0=straight fans, 1=tightly coiled coral)

style.doc: render philosophy: luminous delta / chunky coral / ember autumn / deep-sea bio / flat sumi ink
